body:
## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Design dependency
Refs #455 — owner-selected contract and visual gate. Depends on approved prototype/spec, plus explicit routing. Refs #442/#444; do not duplicate gait #448 or repository ordering #449.

## Small scope
Extend RanchPainter.sky only, consuming the wind/foliage child's shared timing/lifecycle contract. Existing stars twinkle and clouds oscillate slightly; add perceptible but restrained cloud drift and coherent slow star-field/Milky Way movement with seamless coverage. It is stylized atmosphere, not an astronomical/weather simulation. No shooting stars, sound, seasons or particle system extras.

## Source
https://github.com/jirathip-dev/corral/blob/86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982/ios/FleetNotifier/UI/Herd/RanchEnvironment.swift#L57-L90

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Day clouds gently drift; Night star field/Milky Way shows approved slow positional movement as well as restrained existing twinkle. No flashing or high-contrast distracting motion.
- [ ] No popping, wrap seams, blank edges or discontinuities while moving through paddocks at phone widths; preserve moon/landmark composition and distinguish environment drift from user-scroll parallax.
- [ ] Stable seeded geometry across frames/refresh; elapsed time changes motion, not random star identity. Reset/resume does not cause distracting jumps; static Reduce Motion composition is intentional.
- [ ] Reuse shared clock and active/obscured/background/Low Power policy; no independent sky timers or retained work in Board. Do not redraw unchanged expensive blurred layers unnecessarily without measurement.
- [ ] Actual renderer phase tests distinguish position changes from brightness-only changes; real-time native motion clips with labeled elapsed interval prove sky and cloud behavior, not only time-lapse or screenshots.
- [ ] Record phone-scale Day/Night plus scroll-transition evidence, named build/device and frame/CPU measurements; physical device visual gate remains explicit. Native/CI gates pass.

## Dependency / ownership
After the shared wind/timing child and visual approval; small sky-only diff in RanchEnvironment.swift. Serialize against wind changes to that same file. No horse-art, model, shell or network changes.
title: Herd ambience: add gentle cloud drift and slow moving night sky
